releaseChanges: Redesign the workbench around a film monitor, shot timeline, properties inspector and expandable work panels
Add storyboard canvas navigation, shot thumbnails, and a minimap
Add asset search and filtering, a plain-language edit popover, and clearer action feedback
Retry transient Windows Chromium screenshot failures during local rendering
compatibility: Uses the DSH locale service for Chinese and English UI. Project schema remains v3 and reads v1/v2; existing film content is preserved. Legacy production mode needs explicit confirmation. Public mutations require expectedRevision. The left navigation entry remains available when optional conversation or right-sidebar APIs are absent.
